fact_pattern.text: Sunil de Silva purchased Lots 3 and 9 in Partition Plan No 2945 dated 25th April 2012 maade by B.P.. Fernando Licensed Surveyor in Partition Case No.5679/P in the District Court of Kalutara from Padmini Perera, Sarath Pecera and Gamini Perera by Deed of Transfer No.2551 dated 1st May 2013 attested by L.W Perera Notary Public. He amalgamated the said 3 Lots by Plan No. 2010 dated 15th May 2015 by Suntmal Peins Licensed Surveyor and divided into 2 lots namely Lotánd2 each 20 perches in extent. He sold Lot 1 to Anil Perera with the idea of putting up a house on Lot 2 with that money. But before that he died intestate on 2nd August 2015 leaving as his heirs his wife Kusuma and his 2 children Bimal and Kanchana. Kusum was previously married with a child named Weruni who was living with them. Kusum gifted her share to her 3 Children in equal proportions. Bimal filed Testamentary proceedings in Distict Court Kalutara bearing No. 578/T to administer the Intestate estate of Sunil de Silva. While the Testamentary case was pending Bimal met with an accident and died on 4/5/2016. He was married to Aruni and was issueless. Kusum died intestate on 13/6/17 before the Testamentary proceedings were ended.

fact_pattern.text: Lot 3 of the land called Mahatenna in extent of 30 perches in Plan No. 251 dated 5/7/1999 made by A.Samaranayaka Liscensed Surveyor is registered in the Homagama Land Registry under Vol/Folio A 350/25. The owner, sub divided Lot 3 into 2 lots namely Lots 34 and 3B as depicted in Plan No.255 dated 8/12/2000 made by the same Surveyor. He sold Lot 3A to Dininda Perera by Deed No.351 attested by Gamini Herath, Notary Public. Lot 3A was sold at a price of Rupees 7 million but the Commissioner of Revenue of the Western Provincial Council in his opinion of valuation for stamp duty, values the property at Rupees 7.5 million. Dininda Perera constructed a house on Lot 3A and Leased it out to Nimal Fernando for 2 years on a monthly rental of Rs. 75,000/-, He obtained 1 years rent as an advance to set off against 2nd years rent. When the Lease Agreement was submitted for registration the Land Registry informed that it could not be registered because the sub division of Lot 3A is wrongfully registered in the same folio as the original land (Lot 3) is registered namely in Vol/Folio A 350/25.
